text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka showed the world her true 
strength at the GⅠ race, the Takarazuka 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
“There are only 4 months left until the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!”

"As a prep race, I'd like to run in the 
Mainichi Okan at Tokyo Racecourse, the 
same venue."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Are you referring to the Mainichi Okan?

I nod firmly in response to her 
anticipating my thoughts. Beyond 
overcoming this lies the Autumn Tenno Sho.

And so, with our next goal set on the 
Mainichi Okan— we began our days of 
training to push beyond our limits.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, what nice weather—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
This is a declaration of waaar, 
Suzuka-senpai! Please race against me!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: El-san...?!

(El Condor Pasa—an Umamusume with a 
pro-wrestling spirit who aims to be the 
strongest in the world, and a classmate of 
Special Week's.)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Let's run together on a 2,200m 
right-handed turf course! Actually, a 
1,800m left-handed course works too, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The race starts in five minutes! Burning 
fiiiireee!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, El. You really shouldn't interrupt 
Suzuka-senpai's training~

(Grass Wonder—a Yamato Nadeshiko Umamusume 
imbued with traditional grace and 
harboring a fierce determination. She is 
also a classmate of Special Week's.)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"B-Because, because, I just couldn't wait 
until the Mainichi Okan!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"There is no need to rush; the race isn't 
going anywhere."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh, Grass is the only one keeping a 
cool face like that...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Even you looked frustrated yesterday—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Pyai!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Suzuka-senpai, I look forward to racing 
with you in the Mainichi Okan.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Come now, El, let us take our leave. We 
shall settle this on the racetrack, 
understood?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grrr! That is why I cannot wait for the 
Mainichi Okan, yes, sirrr!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Still, Grass is right. There's no point 
in winning unofficial street matches, 
desu...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Let's meet at the Mainichi Okan! 
Suzuka-senpai!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
To prove I'm the "World's Strongest," 
defeating you is an absolute requirement, 
yeeesss!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...

Facing a junior who channeled all her 
boiling passion into the challenge—

"—She could only watch in stunned silence 
as they left."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Don't look at them with such a 
blank face.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Air Groove...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I couldn't help overhearing the 
whole thing.

Her expression was back to normal, making 
the frustrated face she showed right after 
the Takarazuka Kinen feel like an 
illusion.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It seems... the Takarazuka Kinen was quite 
a shock to them.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Yesterday truly was special. For me as 
well."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Still, why are those girls getting so 
hyped up...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, what is it? Good grief, you haven't 
changed one bit in that regard."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... To them, you are a wall that 
they must overcome to move beyond—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: In other words, "light", huh.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "Light"...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She's a guiding beacon, and a 
brilliance lying at the end of the road I 
sprint upon—one that I must surpass.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...So that was what it was all about.

The true meaning behind her juniors' 
enthusiasm. It wasn't an unusual feeling 
to be directed at Silence Suzuka, but—

—It was the very first time she truly 
recognized it and accepted it for herself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh... I'm glad to see you've understood.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still... You always end up stealing the 
spotlight from me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, I just thought that was the kind of 
figure I aspired to be.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Worry not. I already sorted through my 
feelings yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will merely do what I must. So you do 
what you need to do, as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Don't you dare lose at the Mainichi Okan.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, sorry for bothering you, 
Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Air Groove...!

Air Groove's back as she walked straight 
away was as powerful as ever.

—And so, the curtain fell open on the 
cross-generational clash at the Mainichi 
Okan.
